How I work

A simple, clear process — you always know what's happening, what it costs, and when it will be ready.

STEP 01

Tell me your idea

Message me from the Contact page with what you want to build. Rough ideas are fine — I'll ask the right questions.

STEP 02

Clear quote & timeline

You get a fixed price and a delivery date in writing before anything starts. No surprises later.

STEP 03

I build, you review

I write the code and share progress you can actually see. Your feedback shapes the final result.

STEP 04

Delivery & support

You receive the finished work, ready to use. Payments are collected securely through payment links or QR codes, and I stay available for support after delivery.

A developer who answers his own messages

No agency, no middlemen, no hand-offs. When you hire me, you talk directly to the person writing your code — from the first question to the final delivery. That's how small projects stay fast, honest and affordable.

Common questions

How much does a project cost?

It depends on what you need built. Tell me about your project on the Contact page and I'll give you a fixed quote in writing — asking is free, and there's no obligation to go ahead.

How do payments work?

A part of the agreed amount is paid in advance to book the work, and the balance on delivery. Payments are made online through secure payment links or QR codes (UPI and other standard methods). The full terms are on the Terms & Conditions and Refund Policy pages linked in the footer.

How long will my project take?

Small tools and simple websites usually take days, not months. You'll get a clear timeline with your quote, and I'll tell you honestly if something will take longer.

What do you need from me to start?

Just a description of what you want, and any content (text, photos, logins) the project needs. If you're not sure, ask — I'll give you a short list.

What if something breaks after delivery?

Tell me. If the delivered work has a defect against what we agreed, I'll fix it — see the Refund Policy in the footer for exactly how this works.

Have something to build?

Tell me about it in a few lines. You'll get a clear reply, an honest price, and a timeline — before you pay anything.

Terms & Conditions

The plain, fair terms that apply when you hire me for software development work.

LAST UPDATED · NOVEMBER 2026

1. Who I am and what I provide

This website is operated by Akash S, an individual freelance software developer based in Bengaluru, Karnataka, India. I provide freelance software development services — websites, bots, automation and small software tools — to clients who contact me through this website (the "Services").

2. Project agreement

Every project begins with a written agreement (by email or message) covering the scope of work, the fixed price, and the delivery timeline. Work outside the agreed scope is quoted and charged separately. Nothing is charged that was not agreed in writing first.

3. Payments

  • A part of the agreed amount is payable in advance to book and start the work; the balance is payable on delivery, unless a different schedule is agreed in writing.
  • Payments are collected online through payment links or QR codes processed by authorised payment service providers (UPI and other standard payment methods).
  • If a payment is delayed beyond the agreed date, work on the project may be paused until it is received.

4. Client responsibilities

Clients provide the content, materials and access (such as text, images and logins) the project needs, and give feedback within a reasonable time. Delays in providing these may extend the delivery timeline by a similar period.

5. Revisions

Reasonable revisions within the agreed scope are included so the finished work matches what was agreed. Requests that add new features or change the agreed scope are treated as additional work and quoted separately.

6. Ownership

On receipt of full payment, the client owns the final delivered work. I keep the right to reuse general skills, techniques and non-client-specific code components in future projects, and — unless the client asks otherwise in writing — to mention the project in my portfolio.

7. Third-party services

Projects may rely on third-party services such as hosting, domains, APIs or paid tools. Accounts and costs for these belong to the client, and I am not responsible for outages, price changes or policy changes of third-party providers.

8. Liability

I test all work before delivery, and the Services are provided with reasonable care and skill. To the maximum extent permitted by law, my total liability for any project is limited to the amount the client paid for that project.

9. Cancellation and refunds

Cancellations and refunds are governed by the Refund Policy page linked in the footer of this website, which forms part of these terms.

10. Changes to these terms

These terms may be updated from time to time. The version published on this page at the time a project is agreed is the version that applies to that project.

11. Contact

For any question about these terms, please reach out through the Contact Us page of this website.

Privacy Policy

What information this freelance practice collects, why, and the choices you have.

LAST UPDATED · NOVEMBER 2026

1. Who this policy covers

This policy applies to this website and to the freelance software development services provided by Akash S, an individual developer based in Bengaluru, India.

2. Information I collect

  • Information you share when you get in touch: your name, your contact details, and the details of the project you describe.
  • Project information: content, files and access details you provide so the work can be done.
  • Payment records: records that a payment was made, its amount and status. Your card, bank or UPI credentials are handled directly by the payment service provider and never reach me.

This website itself has no accounts, no login, and does not run its own analytics or advertising trackers.

3. How the information is used

  • To reply to enquiries and prepare quotes.
  • To carry out, deliver and support agreed projects.
  • To maintain payment and billing records as required for accounting and legal purposes.

4. Sharing

Your information is never sold. It is shared only where needed to deliver the work — for example with hosting or payment service providers you approve for your project — or where disclosure is required by law.

5. Retention

Project communications and records are kept for as long as reasonably needed for support, accounting and legal purposes, after which they are deleted or anonymised.

6. Security

Reasonable care is taken to protect the information you share, including keeping access credentials confidential and limiting access to the devices and accounts used for the work.

7. Your choices

You may ask what information about you is held, ask for it to be corrected, or ask for it to be deleted (subject to records that must be kept by law). Make any of these requests through the Contact Us page.

8. Changes and contact

Updates to this policy will be published on this page. For any privacy question, please use the Contact Us page of this website.

Refund Policy

How refunds work for freelance software development services. Simple version: if you don't get the work, you don't pay for it.

LAST UPDATED · NOVEMBER 2026

1. Scope of this policy

This policy covers payments made for software development services (websites, bots, automation and tools). All work is delivered digitally — no physical products are sold and nothing is shipped, so no shipping charges or shipping refunds arise.

2. If you cancel before work begins

If you cancel after paying an advance but before work on your project has started, the advance is refunded in full.

3. If you cancel after work has started

If work has started but not been delivered, you are refunded the amount you paid minus the fair value of the work already completed, assessed against the milestones and scope agreed in writing for the project.

4. After delivery

Work that has been delivered as agreed is not refundable. However, if the delivered work contains a defect against the agreed scope, report it within 7 days of delivery and it will be fixed at no extra charge.

5. If I cannot complete the work

If, for any reason on my side, I cannot complete your project, you will be refunded in full for any part of the work that was paid for but not delivered.

6. Third-party costs

Amounts spent, with your approval, on third-party items for your project (such as domain names, hosting or paid tools) are not refundable, because those providers do not return them.

7. How to request a refund

Send your request through the Contact Us page with your name and a short description of the project. Approved refunds are made to the original payment method or source account, and are normally processed within 7–10 business days, depending on the payment provider and bank.
